picks.editorial_note: An $874 million federal commitment across seven companies to rebuild domestic semiconductor R&D capacity is one of the largest single funding actions of the week and directly underwrites the compute supply chain that all AI research depends on.

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $100 million hub program is a national-scale infrastructure investment that will reshape compute access for AI-enabled science across dozens of institutions and build the workforce pipeline behind it.
picks.title: New NSF State and Regional AI Infrastructure Hubs will power AI-enabled scientific research across the country

picks.editorial_note: UC Davis's brain-computer interface restoring an ALS patient's own voice is a genuine scientific milestone with immediate, tangible human impact beyond the lab.
